title: Conditional κ = .003650982374396 (+0.0086612586% over #7642; +0.0147414879% over #7605): rechart the 134/329 contact
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ = 0.003650982374396.** The gain over the fully reproduced [#7642](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7642) at `d7f82810689ed2cd649ec9aaaf3b1485b585c82e`, κ `0.003650666180757`, is exactly `0.000000316193639` or **+0.0086612586%**. The directed check also clears its raw crossing. Compared with the latest same-contract peer [#7605](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7605), published κ `0.0036504442446`, the two campaign steps total `0.000000538129796` or **+0.0147414879%**. Against #7605’s independently reproduced value `0.003650444244716` the total is `0.000000538129680` or **+0.0147414847%**.

The latest higher [#7641 peer claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7641) at `351b09cd4b7ef8e0a24d954a761867960cbb1627` reports κ `0.0037136318149` under its inherited common-U requirements. Its changed-grid precision and tape checks remain open. Across those premises the arithmetic difference is `−0.000062649440504` or **−1.6870127042%**.

Move ADD41051 between roles 134 and 329 from chart 618 to 373. Both independent values return in the old charts before their original readers. The 17-call signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) caller remains at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Exact normalized operations, owned interfaces and all 74 original CLEARs agree. All five original premises carry through.

Seven changed routes and three transfer compositions pass all 512 forward and adjoint columns. Missing-paid, omitted-ADD, wrong-chart and wrong-phase controls reject. Exact signed bills pass both price engines, 3,041 catalogue maps, 104 main boundaries, and 54 strict plus four functional outer inequalities.

Paid positions `110349→110332` with 22,461 productive positions and surplus 1,424. Ordinary bound `782685204→782668204`. Precision coefficient `2430`. Elementary tape records `25448575552→25445676576`.
